title: The Lost Sheep
reflectionQuestion: What do you think the little sheep felt when it heard the shepherd's voice say, 'I found you'?
kidSafetyNotes: PARABLE -- Jesus's teaching picture; frame made explicit at the close (Adam edit): 'God loves you, just like that good shepherd loved his one little sheep,' so kids know it's a picture, not a literal sheep-hunt. The SIGNATURE story for the lane's confirmed 'God is with me / not alone' spine in its tenderest form: 'when I wander, God comes looking for me.' The lost sheep is alone/afraid but NOT in danger (no predators -- keep it about lostness + love, not peril). One image: carried home on the shepherd's shoulders. Supersedes legacy kid_502_lostsheep_short.

scriptureKeyVerse.text: When he comes home, he calls together his friends and his neighbors, saying to them, ‘Rejoice with me, for I have found my sheep which was lost!’
